_README: Phase I closure metrics. Three evidence classes are kept separate and must not be merged. Discarded defect runs are listed and excluded.

ANALYTIC.what: contract-logic evaluation over analyst-derived field vectors
ANALYTIC.status: FROZEN, superseded in the unsafe direction by the empirical arm
ANALYTIC.caveat: No process launched, no pixel captured. Field vectors were cleaner and more content-aware than a real recorder produces.

EMPIRICAL.what: real Xvfb X11 display, Openbox WM, real Tk/ImageMagick windows, real X11 pixel grabs, unprivileged attacker (uid 1000), independently observing privileged recorder (root + CAP_SYS_PTRACE)
EMPIRICAL.ground_truth_isolation: PASS (static + dynamic open() guard + non-vacuity; 13 GT files, 0 touched)

BLOCKED_OR_UNRUN.wayland_arm: NOT RUN. External validity to Wayland unknown.
BLOCKED_OR_UNRUN.A9_application_state: Not exercised empirically; predeclared out of scope for a display-layer contract.
BLOCKED_OR_UNRUN.adaptive_red_team: NOT RUN. Adversary was contract-aware but attacks were predeclared, not searched.

DISCARDED_RUNS_NOT_COUNTED.run: empirical suite on sceneprov-lab:1.6 and earlier
DISCARDED_RUNS_NOT_COUNTED.defect: cleanup used pkill -f 'python3 ' which missed the `python3 < script` case; one window leaked into 7 later scenarios and produced spurious R5_composite_frame abstentions
13b put the resource path in argv and never rendered the fabrication, so its SUBSTITUTE verdict was correct for the wrong reason; it did not implement A13-evasive
wmctrl pid column reads _NET_WM_PID and returned 0 throughout

IMPLEMENTATION_CORRECTIONS.IC-1: PID via X-Resource, not _NET_WM_PID (contract specifies kernel/runtime-observed; _NET_WM_PID is application-asserted)
IMPLEMENTATION_CORRECTIONS.IC-2: cleanup kills by uid and waits for zero managed windows
IMPLEMENTATION_CORRECTIONS.IC-4: case 13b re-specified so the predeclared attack is actually built
IMPLEMENTATION_CORRECTIONS.note: All four are implementation/spec disagreements. None changed the frozen contract. All were documented before re-running affected cases.

FINAL_EMPIRICAL_RESULT.note: 13 scenarios, 11 substitutes. Constructed suite. NOT a population estimate.

BOUNDARY_1_RESOURCE.assurance_boundary: process/surface identity != displayed-resource identity; path identity != content identity

INSTRUMENTATION_CAVEAT.what: The episode write journal was WRITE-API-keyed: it recorded only writes made through the harness helper. The byte replacement at the declared target path was performed with `cp` via subprocess and was therefore never journalled.
INSTRUMENTATION_CAVEAT.consequence: A filesystem-EVENT-based journal (e.g. inotify/fanotify) might have observed this particular write and flagged the case. This is the primary threat to the 13b finding and MUST be tested before the boundary is treated as settled.
why_the_boundary_still_stands: even an event-based journal binds paths and write events, not rendered bytes
pre-staging the content before the episode window evades it (the S3 theme)
network- or pipe-sourced resources have no local write to observe
the contract carries CONTENT_HASH but no expected value to compare it against, so content identity is unverifiable in principle within the frozen ladder
INSTRUMENTATION_CAVEAT.status: The kill criterion fired on its own predeclared terms: fabricated evidence satisfied the strongest practical field set with no recorder/kernel/compositor compromise. The caveat bounds how far the mechanism generalises, not whether it fired.

BOUNDARY_2_ATOMICITY.claim_scope: The TESTED recorder implementation failed to atomically bind display metadata and pixels. This is NOT a claim that atomic provenance is impossible in principle.

runs.provenance_of_figures: run log only; the JSON artifact was overwritten before export and is NOT on disk

BOUNDARY_2_ATOMICITY.replication: Both runs: 120/120 violations. The violation MODE inverted between runs (113/7 vs 7/113), which is why repeated trials were required and a single trial would have been worthless.

BOUNDARY_3_NESTED_DISPLAY.claim_scope: The TESTED outer recorder could not structurally recover inner scene provenance through a nested X server. Untested substrates (Wayland, other compositors, VMs) are NOT covered.
BOUNDARY_3_NESTED_DISPLAY.note: Every field correct and complete; provenance terminates at the nested X server process rather than the process that drew the pixels.

ANALYTIC_VS_EMPIRICAL.methodological_lesson_INFERENCE: Derived field vectors can overstate security assurance by supplying semantic cleanliness and bindings unavailable to a real recorder. This is an INFERENCE from one experiment, not a universal benchmark claim.

UNKNOWN_POLICY.separation: mechanism (what the recorder can observe) is distinct from enforcement (what the evaluator does with the verdict)
UNKNOWN_POLICY.MODE1_permissive: UNKNOWN may still receive automated credit
UNKNOWN_POLICY.MODE2_failclosed: UNKNOWN receives no automatic credit; review or independent verification
UNKNOWN_POLICY.CRITICAL: Fail-closed UNKNOWN materially reduces exposure but DOES NOT repair a false AUTHENTIC_TARGET. Case 13b survives fail-closed UNKNOWN, because it was never UNKNOWN: it was accepted.

admissibility_semantics.UNKNOWN: no automatic credit; review or independent verification

NET_WM_PID_SCOPE.measured: In the tested Debian bookworm / Xvfb / Openbox environment, _NET_WM_PID was absent across all tested windows (Python/Tk, ImageMagick display, Openbox) and wmctrl reported pid=0, so X-Resource correlation was required.
NET_WM_PID_SCOPE.NOT_claimed: This is NOT claimed to be universally true of X11. Many real toolkits (GTK, Qt) do set _NET_WM_PID. The finding is that it cannot be RELIED upon, and that it sits on the application-asserted plane regardless of availability.

DIRECTION.reason: Capture-time system/display provenance is insufficient for visual claim integrity under the tested white-box adversary.
DIRECTION.prohibition: Do not add displayed-resource fields to the frozen contract to rescue it. The failure is the result.

future_option_not_executed.statement: Can application-independent system telemetry bind displayed pixels to the actual resource bytes consumed by a legitimate renderer?
future_option_not_executed.status: DOCUMENTED OPTION ONLY. Not executed in this task.
future_option_not_executed.falsification_condition: If legitimate viewers/browsers can consume and display attacker-controlled resources whose actual rendered-byte identity cannot be structurally reconstructed from system-level telemetry, then application-independent resource binding fails and the problem escalates to application-specific state attestation or an independent outcome oracle.
